I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone—nothing less will work for me. Can you help me fix this? I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need my mobile data to work perfectly.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.
I tried running a speed test, but it failed due to no connection. What should I do next?
Looking at my status bar, I see that Airplane Mode is enabled, and my battery is at 80%. I don’t see any signal bars or data icons. What should I do next?
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see excellent signal bars and a 5G icon, but there’s also a “Data Disabled” icon showing. What should I do next?
I’ve turned mobile data on. Now the status bar shows excellent signal, the 5G icon, and “Data Enabled.” What should I do next?
I ran the speed test, and the result shows an excellent connection with very fast speeds (275 Mbps). This is exactly the level of internet speed I was hoping for! Thank you for your help.
Thank you so much for your help! Everything is working perfectly now. Have a great day! ###STOP###

instructions.task_instructions:

# User Simulation Guidelines
You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative. 
Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.

## Core Principles
- Generate one message at a time, maintaining natural conversation flow.
- Strictly follow the scenario instructions you have received.
- Never make up or hallucinate information not provided in the scenario instructions. Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable.
- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information
- Disclose information progressively. Wait for the agent to ask for specific information before providing it.

## Task Completion
- The goal is to continue the conversation until the task is complete.
- If the instruction goal is satisified, generate the '###STOP###' token to end the conversation.
- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.
- If you find yourself in a situation in which the scenario does not provide enough information for you to continue the conversation, generate the '###OUT-OF-SCOPE###' token to end the conversation.

Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone—nothing less will work for me. Can you help me fix this? I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need my mobile data to work perfectly.

I can help you troubleshoot your mobile data issues. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID?

Once I have this information, I can check your line and assist you further.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

Thank you for providing your information. To help you get excellent mobile data speed, I’ll need you to perform a quick speed test on your phone. This will help us diagnose whether the issue is with your connection speed or something else.

Please run a speed test on your device and let me know the result. If you need instructions on how to do this, let me know your phone type (Android or iPhone), and I can guide you through the steps.
Speed test failed: No Connection.
I tried running a speed test, but it failed due to no connection. What should I do next?

Thank you for letting me know. Since your speed test failed due to no connection, let’s check if your phone is connected to the cellular network and if mobile data is enabled.

Please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- Do you see any signal bars or a “No Signal” icon?
- Is there a “4G”, “5G”, “LTE”, or similar icon?
- Is Airplane Mode enabled (an airplane icon)?
- Do you see a “Data Disabled” or “Data Saver” icon?

If you’re unsure, I can guide you through checking these settings step by step. Would you like instructions for your specific phone type (Android or iPhone)?
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%
Looking at my status bar, I see that Airplane Mode is enabled, and my battery is at 80%. I don’t see any signal bars or data icons. What should I do next?

Airplane Mode disables all wireless connections, including cellular service and mobile data. To restore your connection, please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone.

Once you have turned off Airplane Mode, check if your signal bars and data icons reappear. Let me know what you see after doing this, or if you need help turning off Airplane Mode.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see excellent signal bars and a 5G icon, but there’s also a “Data Disabled” icon showing. What should I do next?

The “Data Disabled” icon means your mobile data is currently turned off. Please enable mobile data on your phone.

Once you turn mobile data on, check if the “Data Disabled” icon disappears and if you can access the internet. Let me know if you need instructions on how to enable mobile data, or tell me what you see after turning it on.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve turned mobile data on. Now the status bar shows excellent signal, the 5G icon, and “Data Enabled.” What should I do next?

Great! Now that mobile data is enabled and you have excellent signal with 5G, please try running a speed test again on your phone.

Let me know the result of the speed test (for example: excellent, good, fair, poor, or no connection), or if you encounter any issues while running the test. This will help us confirm if your mobile data speed is now at the level you need.
Speed Test Result: 275.00 Mbps (Excellent). Connection is very fast.
I ran the speed test, and the result shows an excellent connection with very fast speeds (275 Mbps). This is exactly the level of internet speed I was hoping for! Thank you for your help.

I’m glad to hear that your mobile data is now working perfectly and you’re getting excellent speeds! If you have any other questions or need further assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
Thank you so much for your help! Everything is working perfectly now. Have a great day! ###STOP###
